newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-STEELERS RE-SIGN QUARTERBACK MIKE TOMCZAK.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-STEELERS RE-SIGN QUARTERBACK MIKE TOMCZAK.

text.p: The Pittsburgh Steelers, decimated by free-agent losses this year, stemmed the tide Thursday by signing Mike Tomczak, their starting quarterback last season.

Tomczak, a 13-year veteran and an unrestricted free-agent, guided the Steelers to a 10-6 mark last season, his first as a starter for Pittsburgh. He completed 55 percent of his passes for 2,767 yards and 15 touchdowns, but threw 17 interceptions and was ineffective in Pittsburgh's 28-3 AFC divisional playoff loss at New England.

The Steelers, who had 14 unrestricted free agents at the end of the season, have lost wide receiver Ernie Mills and defensive end Ray Seals to the Carolina Panthers, and linebacker Chad Brown and cornerback Willie Williams to the Seattle Seahawks.
Running back Jerome Bettis is the only other free agent retained by the Steelers.
